subject: Life Skills
title: The Permanence of Digital Words
description: One-minute skill: The Permanence of Digital Words.

hook.text: A tweet from a teenager cost a corporate executive her job ten years later when it resurfaced.

buildup.text: Unlike spoken words, digital messages are searchable, screenshot-able, and forwardable forever.

discovery.text: Even disappearing messages can be screenshotted in a fraction of a second before they vanish.

twist.text: Deleting a message removes it from your screen but not from the recipient's memory or storage.

climax.text: Before hitting send, imagine it read aloud in a courtroom. If that feels wrong, rewrite it.

punchline.text: The internet doesn't forgive. Write accordingly.

quiz.question: Why are disappearing messages not truly private?
options: They never actually disappear from the server
They can be screenshotted before vanishing
They are visible to the app developer
